armored-rhinoceros.attribution: Zentralbibliothek Zürich 5.1: a-5.3; image 627406; section De rhinocerote.
armored-rhinoceros.description: A rhinoceros walking to the left in profile, its body covered in plated armour with scalloped edges, mail-like hatching on the legs, a single horn on the nose and a small twisted horn on the shoulder, after Dürer's 1515 woodcut. Black woodcut line on the beige paper tone of the page, which is kept inside the outline; the background outside the figure is transparent.
armored-rhinoceros.quality: A small brown foxing spot on the near front foot.
armored-rhinoceros.title: Armoured rhinoceros
usage_notes: The paper tone inside the figure is kept, so it reads as a cut-out of the printed page; place it on a light or mid-toned ground.

beaver.attribution: Zentralbibliothek Zürich 5.1: a-5.3; image 626789; section De castore.
beaver.description: A beaver walking to the right in profile with its mouth open to show the long incisors, dense hatched fur, clawed feet and the flat scaly paddle tail trailing to the left. Black woodcut line on the beige paper tone of the page, which is kept inside the outline; the background outside the figure is transparent.
beaver.title: Beaver
usage_notes: The paper tone inside the figure is kept, so it reads as a cut-out of the printed page; place it on a light or mid-toned ground.
Wide strip (about 2.5:1) that works as a footer or title band.

cat.attribution: Zentralbibliothek Zürich 5.1: a-5.3; image 626798; section De cato seu fele.
cat.description: A tabby cat sitting upright and looking straight at the viewer, with pointed ears, long whiskers, banded stripes across the chest and flanks and the tail curled around the front paws. Black woodcut line on the beige paper tone of the page, which is kept inside the outline; the background outside the figure is transparent.

provenance.object_identifier: 5.1: a-5.3; image 626798; section De cato seu fele.
provenance.object_title: Gessner, Historiae animalium: De cato seu fele.

cat.quality: Printed text from the other side of the leaf shows faintly through the chest.
cat.title: Seated tabby cat
usage_notes: The paper tone inside the figure is kept, so it reads as a cut-out of the printed page; place it on a light or mid-toned ground.

crocodile.attribution: Zentralbibliothek Zürich 5.1: a-5.3; image 2119273; section De crocodilo.
crocodile.description: A crocodile seen from above and slightly from the side, its head at the left with the jaws wide open to show rows of teeth, four splayed legs, a back of square plates and a long ringed tail curling up to the right. Black woodcut line on the beige paper tone of the page, which is kept inside the outline; the background outside the figure is transparent.
crocodile.quality: Narrow strips of bare paper remain outside the ink at the jaws and along the tail tip.
crocodile.title: Crocodile
usage_notes: The paper tone inside the figure is kept, so it reads as a cut-out of the printed page; place it on a light or mid-toned ground.

elephant.attribution: Zentralbibliothek Zürich 5.1: a-5.3; image 626863; section De elephanto.
elephant.description: An elephant walking to the right in profile, with a large fan-shaped ear, two tusks, the trunk curling down and inward, columnar legs on flat round feet and a thin tufted tail. Black woodcut line on the beige paper tone of the page, which is kept inside the outline; the background outside the figure is transparent.
elephant.title: Elephant
usage_notes: The paper tone inside the figure is kept, so it reads as a cut-out of the printed page; place it on a light or mid-toned ground.

elk-antler.attribution: Zentralbibliothek Zürich 5.1: a-5.3; image 626455; section De alce.
elk-antler.description: A single palmated antler of a European elk (moose) standing upright, the broad veined palm rising from a knobbed burr at the lower right and ending in a row of pointed tines along the left edge and across the top. Black woodcut line on the beige paper tone of the page, which is kept inside the outline; the background outside the antler is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Gessner, Historiae animalium: elk antler (De alce)

elk-antler.title: Elk antler
usage_notes: The paper tone inside the antler is kept, so it reads as a cut-out of the printed page; place it on a light or mid-toned ground.
Tall upright piece (about 3:5); pairs with a mirrored copy as a symmetrical ornament.

fox.attribution: Zentralbibliothek Zürich 5.1: a-5.3; image 627534; section De vulpe.
fox.description: A fox sitting on its haunches and facing right, with pointed ears, a narrow whiskered muzzle, shaggy hatched fur and a long bushy tail stretched out along the ground to the left. Black woodcut line on the beige paper tone of the page, which is kept inside the outline; the background outside the figure is transparent.
fox.title: Seated fox
usage_notes: The paper tone inside the figure is kept, so it reads as a cut-out of the printed page; place it on a light or mid-toned ground.

grapes.attribution: Zentralbibliothek Zürich 5.1: a-5.3; image 627095; section De leone.
grapes.description: A tiny bunch of grapes hanging below two broad vine leaves, the stem ending at the top in a short horizontal stub of the branch it grew from, taken from the decorated initial L of the lion chapter. Dark brown printed ink only, a few dozen pixels across; the paper is removed and the background is transparent.
grapes.title: Grape bunch with branch stub
usage_notes: Render at or below the master's pixel size; it blurs when enlarged.
Ink only, so it sits on any ground; the branch stub closes the piece, so it stands alone better than the cropped variant.

horse.attribution: Zentralbibliothek Zürich 5.1: a-5.3; image 626896; section De equo.
horse.description: A stallion standing in profile and facing left, with a short upright mane, a long flowing tail reaching the ground and one hind leg raised. Black woodcut line on the beige paper tone of the page, which is kept inside the outline; the background outside the figure is transparent.
horse.quality: Printed text from the other side of the leaf shows through the body, and a faint yellow stain sits on the neck.
horse.title: Standing horse
usage_notes: The paper tone inside the figure is kept, so it reads as a cut-out of the printed page; place it on a light or mid-toned ground.

lion.attribution: Zentralbibliothek Zürich 5.1: a-5.3; image 627095; section De leone.
lion.description: A maned lion walking to the left in profile, with a heavy shaggy mane falling over the shoulders and chest, large paws and a thin tail raised behind and ending in a tuft. Black woodcut line on the beige paper tone of the page, which is kept inside the outline; the background outside the figure is transparent.
lion.quality: Printed text from the other side of the leaf shows faintly through the hindquarters.
lion.title: Walking lion
usage_notes: The paper tone inside the figure is kept, so it reads as a cut-out of the printed page; place it on a light or mid-toned ground.

pear.description: A tiny pear hanging from a stem that continues upward into a short curve ending in a knob where the stalk joined the branch, taken from the decorated initial L of the lion chapter.
